_comment: The join contract for this repository, read by docs/ai-forward-pack/scripts/conductor-join.py
(pack revision 70; it replaced tools/conductor-join.py, which carried these commands inline).
Every command runs as a subprocess gated by its exit code; `python` resolves to the invoking
interpreter. Order inside the join: merge -> audit marker -> verify-no-conflict-markers ->
checks -> recount (timed as recount_seconds) -> audit entry -> regenerate -> commit -> gates ->
recount: `--update` re-baselines the counts even when a test FAILED (its job is the count), so
the closing `--no-run` is the outcome check - a red suite stops the join before the audit entry
and the commit (the F5 join, 2026-09-14: one order-dependent red reached the gates and left a
join commit unpushed). Node reuse is off at the boundary (Directory.Build.rsp, verify-node-reuse-control.py).
gates: tools/run-verify-gates.py is the repo's line over the pack runner - it carries the per-gate
arguments (verify-test-run --no-run; verify-front-door-exit-evidence --self-test until the record lands).
